subject: Discovery recap: migration off OpenAI/Anthropic APIs - FinTechCo
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: migration off OpenAI/Anthropic APIs - FinTechCo

Hey Alex - thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have shared agreement on goals, pain, and next steps. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of what we heard
- Current state: FinTechCo is using OpenAI (chat + embeddings) for several customer-facing flows (support triage, KYC assistant, and semantic search). Also running a small Anthropic pilot for policy-sensitive prompts.
- Pain points:
  - Cost: per-token spend has grown ~3x year-over-year - primary driver to explore alternatives.
  - Vendor lock-in: tight coupling to proprietary APIs (chat completion semantics, streaming) complicates portability.
  - Latency: peak-hour latency spikes impact user experience for live agent assist.
  - Security/compliance: need to ensure private deployments and stronger key management for regulated data.
- Success criteria for migration (what success looks like):
  - Response quality parity with current OpenAI chat in top-3 flows (subjective eval + automated metrics).
  - <=40% of current per-token cost at production throughput or equivalent cost/perf tradeoffs.
  - Smooth engineering migration: minimal changes to runtime (support for chat + function calling + streaming + embedding formats).
  - Security: private deployment option or dedicated tenancy with KMS/HSM and audit logs.

Compatibility & technical constraints
- Need feature parity for: streaming responses, function/tool-calling (webhook-style tool invocations), structured outputs (JSON), and embeddings compatible with their vector store (current vector dim: 1536).
- Quantization preference: will consider int8/4-bit if model quality maintained.
- Latency target: P95 under 300ms for short chat prompts; currently experiencing spikes to ~700ms under load.

Model shortlist we discussed (initial candidates)
- Llama 2 (7B/13B chat variants) - good community support; test for streaming/function compatibility.
- Mistral-7B Chat - promising for instruction chat benchmarks.
- Falcon-7B/1.3B chat variants - strong throughput on GPU.
- RedPajama/Academic models (fine-tuned chat variants) - evaluate for cost/perf.

Next steps (agreed)
1) Redwood: deliver a one-page migration outline + compatibility checklist and suggested model shortlist (attached). (Owner: Rishi) - deliver by Thu, 2026-02-12.
2) Technical PoC: FinTechCo to provide 2 representative prompt sets (support triage + KYC assistant) and a small evaluation dataset (50-100 examples). Redwood to run quality comparatives and perf benchmarks. (Owners: Alex + Marissa) - target week of 2026-02-23.
3) Security follow-up: Redwood to share private deployment options, KMS/HSM integration notes, and SOC2 artifacts. (Owner: Aditya) - initial notes by 2026-02-16.
4) Commercials: high-level pricing guidance for hosted vs dedicated (reserved) capacity. (Owner: Rishi) - include in follow-up.

Attachments: redwood-migration-outline.pdf, fintechco-compatibility-checklist.xlsx

Thanks - will follow up with the PDF and checklist tomorrow.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: migration off OpenAI/Anthropic APIs - FinTechCo

Rishi - thanks for the clear note, that matches my takeaways. A few clarifications: 

- On embeddings: our current OpenAI text-embedding-3-large dims are 1536 and we use cosine similarity; any candidate embedding model needs to be within ~2% MAP of our current results.
- For the KYC assistant we do some strict redaction chaining - we need to validate that any private deployment can run the redaction step before logging or sending to any third-party service.
- Timeline: we'd like a PoC within 2 weeks if possible - we can prioritize the support triage flow first.

I'll attach the sample prompt set and 75 example records to a shared Drive link by EOD. Also please include an estimate for what a 30-day PoC on hosted versus dedicated would cost (ballpark).

Looking forward - Alex

Alex Johnson
Head of AI Platform | FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com | +1 (415) 888-4242

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: migration off OpenAI/Anthropic APIs - FinTechCo

Great - thanks Alex. Quick notes against your clarifications and next steps: 

- Embeddings: we'll run parity checks against text-embedding-3-large (1536 dim) and include MAP/Recall@10 in the PoC report.
- Redaction & security: Aditya will lead a short runbook for redaction-before-logging and how Private/Dedicated deployments meet your KMS/HSM needs.
- Timeline & PoC: we can start the hosted PoC next week and have a 2-week evaluation window. High-level pricing: hosted PoC estimate = $2,500- $4,000 (depending on token volume); dedicated 30-day eval (reserved GPUs) = $18k- $25k (ballpark). We'll refine once we have the prompt set.

Attached: redwood-migration-outline.pdf (one-page plan), fintechco-compatibility-checklist.xlsx, draft SOW (redwood-sow-draft.docx).

Next actions (owner / due)
- Alex: share sample prompt sets + evaluation data (by Thu EOD 2026-02-12)
- Rishi: send PoC kickoff calendar invite + cost estimate (by Fri 2026-02-13)
- Marissa: prepare test harness for chat + function-calling compatibility tests (by Mon 2026-02-16)
- Aditya: share security runbook and SOC2 artifacts (by Mon 2026-02-16)

If that all looks good I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-min PoC kickoff.

Best,
